text: Riftwalker Dellyn is a void elf of the Riftwalkers located on Telogrus Rift.
Riftblade Maella is a void elf riftblade serving under Magister Umbric. Formerly a spellbreaker, Maella admits that she never wanted to become one with the Void and never wanted to leave her home.
Riftwalker Soran is a void elf of the Riftwalkers located on Telogrus Rift.

Riftwalker Tarrowyn is a void elf located in Cosmic Horizon on Telogrus Rift. She can be seen speaking with Riftwalker Soran. When the Shadowguard attacked the area, she helped defend it. Later, Tarrowyn came with her fellow Riftwalkers to K'aresh. She could be found with Riftwalker Eiteiri and Riftwalker Ailaya in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.

Riftwalker Orlis is a void elf located in Cosmic Horizon on Telogrus Rift. The Riftwalkers were recently tasked to investigate Void fluctuations on Azeroth, and he was sent to investigate one such fluctuation in the Eastern Kingdoms. He then returned and reported the status. When the Shadowguard attacked, he died.
Riftwalker Aderian is a void elf located on Telogrus Rift. He can be found standing next to Riftwalker Orlis. When the Shadowguard attacked the Rift, he helped defend the area.

Riftwalker Eiteiri is a void elf located in Cosmic Horizon on Telogrus Rift. When the Rift came under attack from the Shadowguard, she helped defend the area. Later, Eiteiri came with her fellow Riftwalkers to K'aresh. She could be found with Riftwalker Tarrowyn and Riftwalker Ailaya in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.

Riftwalker Nilara is a void elf who, along with other Riftwalkers, were recently tasked to investigate Void fluctuations on Azeroth, and she was sent to investigate one such fluctuation in at Galakrond's Rest in Dragonblight. She did not report back to Magister Umbric with the other Riftwalkers, and he became concerned. Alleria and an adventurer went to search for her, and discovered tracks going north. Alleria sensed something in the north, and wondered if something was happening at Ulduar. Upon arrival to Ulduar, it was discovered that Nilara, persuaded by the Harbinger had given into the whispers and was summoning void forces. Alleria and the adventurer killed her, and Alleria lamented no

Rhythferr is a bronze dragon in human visage located south of the Coreway in Dornogal, as part of the Horrific Visions Revisited base camp. He serves as the champion weaponsmith, selling Adventurer 1 (ilvl 655) weapons in exchange for Displaced Corrupted Mementos after earning Masked Soliloquy (revisited) by clearing with any one mask. He also sells the Warbound Purifying Kit for 1000 mementos, making all future Veteran-track items that drop in visions Warbound. Before patch 11.2.0, he sold Champion 2 (ilvl 639) weapons. Nearby are TickTak, who sells Explorer 2 (ilvl 645) versions of these same weapons, and Chreni, who sells Veteran 1 (ilvl 668) versions.
Riftwarden Theremen is a void elf located in the Masters' Perch in the Voidstorm.
Rift Simulacrum is a projection of Alleria Windrunner that she summons during the Crown of the Cosmos fight in the Voidspire.
Rhys Duskfrost is a blood elf enchanting trainer located at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.
Riftwalker Ein is a void elf located in Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm.
Riftwalker Kaye is a void elf located in Locus Point in Voidstorm.
Riftwalker Malloril is a void elf located in Howling Ridge in Voidstorm.

Risen Nightmare's Gravemantle is the tier 31 death knight set.
Rob Nevins is a human located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span. He is located next to Isadora Nevins, Lynelle Cremer, alongside the cats Mischa and Max.

Roland Meadows was a human foot soldier. He and Jeremiah Pall were part of a division led by Captain Whitney that fought against orcs. Whitney was a cruel man who punished his men harshly for the slightest fault and forced them to sing his praise. Roland had to lie to his own son Abel, writing him a letter that claimed Whitney was a hero who bravely fought many orcs at once. One day, Roland decided he had enough and spoke up against Whitney, threatening to expose him. Whitney slit his throat in response and smiled as he died.
Root Network is a Wildstalker hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Resilient Flourishing.
Rotha is an orc located at the Common in Razorwind Shores. She can be found with four Workers.
Routine Communication is a Farseer shaman hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Heed My Call.

Ruby Skyscorcher is a red dragon located in the Outer Seal in the Vault of the Incarnates. It can be ridden to damage the mobs on the way to Eranog before Raszageth appears and it is forced to retreat.
Rune Carved Plates is a Deathbringer hero talent for death knights. It is an exclusive choice node with Pact of the Deathbringer.
Rushing Wind Kick is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is also granted to Windwalker via the Rushing Wind Kick (monk talent) talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Jadefire Teachings for Mistweaver.

Ryanog was an ice proto-dragon and one of Warbringer Rava's lieutenants. Ryanog discovered a titan-forged stealing eggs from an unattended nest near Wyrmrest Temple and slew it. He, alongside Rava and her other lieutenant Kagoznos, presented its remains and one of the devices it was using to store the stolen eggs to Iridikron.
Ruthless Aggression is a Druid of the Claw hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Killing Strikes.
Rylen Fairfeather is a dead night elf located in Siegehold in Azj-Kahet.
Sanguine Scent is a San'Layn hero talent for death knights. It is an exclusive choice node with Pact of the San'layn.
Sarlene Belayon is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.

Scarlet Boatmaster is a human located in the Decrepit Fields in Silverpine Forest during the Heritage of Lordaeron. He transported the adventurer disguised as a member of the Scarlet Crusade to Fenris Isle. His status afterward is unknown. He may have died in the Forsaken counterattack or escaped.

Scarlet Commander Forsythe is a human located in Fenris Keep in Silverpine Forest during the Heritage of Lordaeron. Leader of the Crusade force that aimed to drive away the Forsaken from the Ruins of Lordaeron, he and his soldiers were attacked by the undead counterattack that comprised of the Forsaken champion and Lilian Voss who personally knew Forsythe from before her resurrection as an undead. After his defeat, the Forsaken celebrated their victory over the Crusade on Fenris Isle.

Sharon Wiltshire is a human located in Newstead in the Arathi Highlands. When the Red Dawn raided the farm, they bound her in a farmhoue, while her daughter escaped with Walker Gresham. When King Danath returned to the Highlands with reinforcements, Maggie asked them to find Sharon. After being rescued, Sharon reunited with her family outside the farm.

Skeinspinner Takazj is a nerubian sage located in the Nerub-ar Palace as part of The Silken Court encounter. She was tasked by Queen Ansurek with spreading propaganda about ascending in the Umbral Bazaar.
Sky-Commander Gadrius Orcbane is a human located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.

Sky-Captain Clairmonte is the captain of the Embers, an airship that travels around Hallowfall. She is one of four sky-captains that need to be spoken to in order to unlock the Sunken Cache treasure containing the Silver Linin' Scepter. The other three are Aerthin (the Righteous Hammer), Dornald (the Mighty Lynx), and Onaro (the Resolute Flame).

Sky-Captain Onaro is the captain of the Resolute Flame, an airship that travels around Hallowfall. She is one of four sky-captains that need to be spoken to in order to unlock the Sunken Cache treasure containing the Silver Linin' Scepter. The other three are Aerthin (the Righteous Hammer), Clairmonte (the Embers), and Dornald (the Mighty Lynx). __NOTOC__

Sky-Captain Dornald is the captain of the Mighty Lynx, an airship that travels around Hallowfall. His lynx Regeneald is sitting next to him. Dornald is one of four sky-captains that need to be spoken to in order to unlock the Sunken Cache treasure containing the Silver Linin' Scepter. The other three are Aerthin (the Righteous Hammer), Clairmonte (the Embers), and Onaro (the Resolute Flame).
Sky-Captain Estraella is the captain of the Empire's Reach II, an airship that travels around Hallowfall.

Sky-Captain Aerthin is the captain of the Righteous Hammer, an airship that travels around the Priory of the Sacred Flame in Hallowfall. He is one of four sky-captains that need to be spoken to in order to unlock the Sunken Cache treasure containing the Silver Linin' Scepter. The other three are Clairmonte (the Embers), Dornald (the Mighty Lynx), and Onaro (the Resolute Flame).

Stromgarde Mage is a human located in High Perch in the Arathi Highlands. She opens a Portal to Dornogal after the conclusion of the Rise of the Red Dawn.

Sun Viceheart is an orc located on a hill south of the Common in Razorwind Shores. He sells alcohol.
Summoner Ravinia is a blood elf located in a cave under the Witherbark Bluffs in Zul'Aman. She summons The Devouring Invader.

Talust'an is a nerubian sage character in the nerubian narrative titled the "Parable of Ivory Silk". According to the tale, he was a sage of great cunning and even greater hubris who "unspooled" his daughter's body and transformed it into a single long, ivory strand. He then presented it to his fellow sages in order to test their omniscience, telling them that the weave contained "the truth of fate, the fate of truth, and all points in between". The other sages were horrified and bound Talust'an in his daughter's webbing, then imprisoned him in a chamber with pools of water on the ground and colonies of berry-bugs above. Whenever he reached down to drink, his daughter's web would unravel and

Tan'dani was a leader of the Witherbark tribe and the Amani Empire as the Thalassian War unfolded. A cunning strategist, Tan'dani led the empire in battle, slowly gaining ground through guerrilla attacks while also suffering heavy losses. In time, the Zandalari Empire offered the Amani aid, promising to help them regain territory in return for nothing but goodwill. Tan'dani was skeptical of these claims and believed that their help would eventually lead to the vassalage of the Amani Empire. Despite having made a diplomatic journey to meet with the Zandalari ambassadors, she disappeared. TickTack is a bronze dragon with a gnomish visage located south of the Coreway in Dornogal, as part of the Horrific Visions Revisited base camp. He serves as the veteran weaponsmith, selling Explorer 2/8 (ilvl 645) weapons in exchange for Displaced Corrupted Mementos after earning Incremental Progress by completing 2 objectives and defeating the final boss. Before patch 11.2.0, he sold Veteran 4/8 (ilvl 632) weapons. Nearby are Rhythferr, who sells Adventurer 1 (ilvl 655) versions of these same weapons, and Chreni, who sells Veteran 1 (ilvl 668) versions.

Thuran Whitewind is a human spy who scouted many places in Kalimdor in service of Jaina Proudmoore's forces. Locations he's been to include Feralas, Thousand Needles, and Tanaris. Brann Bronzebeard heard about Thuran while in Theramore and sought him out in hopes of learning more about southern Kalimdor. Though Thuran initially ignored Brann, he opened up once he learned the dwarf's name. Brann plied him with free drinks and the two chatted for a few hours.

Tytalor's Second Biggest Fan is a blood elf mage and student of Falthrien Academy. A zealous supporter of fellow student Tytalor Goldenblade, they attended a duel between Goldenblade and an adventurer visiting the Sunstrider Isle and exclaimed their surprise when the latter was victorious.
Tzurg Lowlock is an orc fruit vendor located in Razorwind Shores.
Tytalor Goldenblade is a blood elf located on Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.
Uberserc is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Unbreakable Bond is a Marksmanship hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Avian Specialization.

Umbral Essentia is the night elf racial Shadowmeld, in potion form. They share the five-minute potion cooldown with other combat potions. Umbral Essentia are created with Khaz Algar Alchemy (25), made with: Alchemists learn Recipe: Umbral Essentia by purchasing it from Om'sirik in Tazavesh at Renown 5 with the K'aresh Trust.
Unhindered Assault is an Aldrachi Reaver hero talent for demon hunters. It is an exclusive choice node with Evasive Action.
Unity Within is a Conduit of the Celestials monk hero talent.
Unholy Armaments is a Rider of the Apocalypse hero talent for death knights.
Unrelenting Siege is a Scalecommander hero talent for evokers.
Unrelenting Charger is a Templar paladin hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Bonds of Fellowship.
Untethered Rage is the apex talent for Vengeance demon hunters.
Uraka is an orc who was planned to appear as part of a vignette.

Vahi Bonesplitter is an orc located at Razor Hill in . She will trade Monster Hunter's First Rune Fragment, Monster Hunter's Second Rune Fragment, and Monster Hunter's Third Rune Fragment to warriors in exchange for Severed Quilboar Head, Severed Harpy Head, and Severed Centaur Head, respectively.

Vak'kan is an orc who serves as Monte Gazlowe's bodyguard. He accompanied the goblin during his visit to Marin Noggenfogger's mine and helped him regain his balance when he almost fell to his death because of faulty railings. Vak'kan then began threatening Noggenfogger, suspecting he was behind the assassination attempt, but Gazlowe called him off. Vak'kan only communicated in grunts and snorts. He later appeared in the Undermine.
Ursine Fury is a Pack Leader hunter hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Sharpened Claws.
Vaelith Sunplume is a blood elf located at Thuron's Livery at Eversong Woods.

Vaelgor is a void dragon located on the Isle of Quel'Danas when the Devouring Host invaded it. Once a red dragon, he and his brother Ezzorak were corrupted into void dragons. They can be found laying siege to Parhelion Plaza. The two were eventually slain within the Voidspire.
Urs'endris is an ursera spirit beast located on a small isle on the eastern Zephras Isle.
Vallorum Rayfierce is a blood elf located in the northern part of the Southfury River in the Northern Barrens. Next to her is a Dog and a Lemon Silverleaf Tea.
Valdekar Solaar is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Van Amburgh is a dwarf located in . His companions are Anne Tenna, Bearthold, and Roary. Estelenn and Banteazo were looking for Van Amburgh.
Vanira Raventhorne is a hero card from the War of the Elements set.
Veanna Cloudsleeper is a night elf druid located in the during Nightmare Incursions.
Velaryn Bloodwrath is a blood elf located in the Wastes of K'aresh in the Manaforge Omega. She is one of The Soul Hunters.
Vehn Sorrelstride is a blood elf located at Goldenmist Village in Eversong Woods.
Ventus Prideshade is a void elf located at the Masters' Perch in the Voidstorm.

Veronica Nials is a human and high-ranking member of the Red Dawn. Once a captain of the Stromic army, Veronica was promoted to the rank colonel in command of Stromgarde during King Danath Trollbane's absence in Khaz Algar. However, she was secretly a follower of Lady Marran Trollbane and helped her organize a civil war, which ended with the defeat and exile of the Red Dawn from the Arathi Highlands.
Verlann Timbercrush is an orc located in the Emerald Dream. She is the final encounter in the Superbloom.
Verilas Sunblood is a blood elf located in the Steam Pools in Feralas during Love is in the Air.
Versatile Divinations was an Oracle hero talent for priests. It was an exclusive choice node with Perfect Vision.
Ves'trak is a nerubian sage located in Rak-Ush in Azj-Kahet.
Veteran Vitality is a Colossus hero talent for warriors. It is an exclusive choice node with No Stranger to Pain.
Vexemia is a black dragon who was once Moraidormi's friend until she was corrupted and she killed Moraidormi in the Ruins of Uldum in Tanaris.
